chapter: On the road, James Brown and the 1956 crash
title: Coast to coast on crutches, then giving up and returning to Houston in 1959
summary: Cobb worked from 1957 to February 1959, twice crossing the country on crutches, then quit and flew home to Houston with his daughter on June 4.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well now, after this thing you played what, for about a year with the group?
Now, when you come out with the -- after the --
Oh, after the accident, after you finished with the hospital, what do you do then?
No, I come back in '57, and I worked all the way through until I just barely, in '59 February in Philadelphia.
I worked there, but I went coast to coast twice on crutches.

And that's when I gave it up. I said, 'It's too much.' And come back to New York, bus, snow and kicking with my feet to try to get through and can't bend my leg, pick my feet up. I say, 'I've had it.' I told my wife, I said, I says, this is --
So when you -- when in '59 you come back here --
Yeah, June the 4th my daughter and I got in. We came from the Newark airport, Eastern... Give me a -- Easter, you know, light --
Well, I brought you another match.
Yeah, I brought you a couple.
